picks.title: Google Unveils Gemini That Remembers Brand Style
picks.excerpt: Gemini can now remember a brand's style: register a website, brand kit, fonts and colors once and generate new on-brand images without re-uploading guidelines each time.
picks.rationale: A new Gemini feature that saves a brand kit once and reuses it for every generated image. Brand and marketing designers can try it tomorrow. It is a different product from the 09-28 Stitch brand-to-UI story.

picks.title: 로고 생성 넘어 SVG 편집 파일로...이디오그램, 벡터 AI로 디자인 실무 공략
picks.excerpt: Ideogram has moved from generating logo and illustration images to outputting editable SVG vector files, pitching its vector AI at real design production work rather than finished-looking pictures.
picks.rationale: Ideogram now outputs editable SVG vector files instead of flat images, so logos and icons can go straight into a production pipeline. This is a new capability, not the 10-03 Ideogram partial-edit model and not CorelDRAW's text-to-vector tool from 09-29.

picks.title: Building an AI-ready design system library: Code → Figma with MCP
picks.excerpt: A practical guide for designers on starting the design system in code and using MCP to build, check and maintain the Figma library so AI agents can work from it. Part 1 of a three-part series that continues into AI prototyping inside the design system.
picks.rationale: A step-by-step workflow for building the Figma library from code over MCP so agents can use it, which design-system teams can follow directly. It is a practitioner how-to, not Figma's 10-17 code-layers launch or the 10-24 Figma-agent design-system post. This is the second figma-category pick, so it gets the palette accent #7928ca.

picks.title: The New Full-Stack Designer
picks.excerpt: On YC's Design Review, Shopify product design studio lead Marvin Schwaibold walks through how his design process has changed with AI coding tools, the admin redesign and Sidekick work his team shipped, and why taste is now the bottleneck.
picks.rationale: A Shopify studio lead shows the actual process his team used to ship the admin redesign and Sidekick with AI coding tools, a concrete case study rather than a generic essay. It adds a new outlet and covers the social category.

picks.title: MOSS-Image: The Open-Source Model Teaching AI to Spell
picks.excerpt: MOSS-Image is a 5B open-source image model that renders readable bilingual text and JSON-specified layouts, scoring 96.3 on long-text rendering benchmarks.
picks.rationale: A new open-source image model built for readable typography and layouts specified in JSON, which addresses designers' main complaint about AI posters. It is a different model from the 10-13 Iris 3B story. The source is a lower-tier outlet, so the enrichment pass should check the claims against the model card.
